about_short_description.short_description: Beautiful indoor plants – potted, styled and delivered.

product.name: Indoor Plants
product.description: Potted indoor plants delivered to homes and offices, available in various sizes and types suited for different light conditions and care levels.

product.name: Planters
product.description: A selection of handcrafted planters made from materials like ceramic, terracotta, and fiberglass, designed for indoor and outdoor use with various sizes and finishes.

product.name: Plant Care Accessories
product.description: Tools and products including moisture meters and natural plant food to assist customers in maintaining healthy indoor plants.

product.name: Plant Animal Decorations
product.description: Small decorative brass-plated steel animal figures designed to attach to plant leaves or stems for aesthetic enhancement.

product.name: Plant Guarantee and Support Service
product.description: A plant guarantee program offering replacement for plants that die within 45 days and extended support including personalized Plant Doctor assistance.
